findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: Upon arrival, the handwashing sink was observed obstructed with a cooking pan and dishes. The cooking equipment was removed from the sink to correct the violation. Given that the handwashing sink is used by multiple parties, the kitchen employee is responsible for keeping the sink free of dishes and unobstructed for handwashing purposes. Ensure that handsinks are always available for employees to wash hands.
findings.citation_text: 5-205.11 Using a Handwashing Sink. (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions.
